Our Plan and Budget is how we make investments in things that matter guided by our Growing with Care
Strategic Plan (/government-and-council/plans-budget-and-performance/strategic-plan-2023-2027/)
. It’s how we support the people of Waterloo Region with:

     Roads and infrastructure
     Paramedic and public health services
     Clean drinking water and wastewater services
     Affordable housing
     Museums and cultural programming
     ...And much more!

Our focus for the 2027 plan and budget is clear in the face of these pressures:

     affordability for residents;
     maintaining critical services; and
     protecting essential infrastructure.

This is a stability-focused budget to ensure that the services our residents rely on remain strong and reliable,
while also supporting our community through a period of economic uncertainty.

Visit the EngageWR webpage (https://www.engagewr.ca/ROW-2027-budget) to share your thoughts and
learn more about the 2027 Plan and Budget process.
